todoContent: Update motor_controller.h to remove ce_m_driver include
functionalSummary: Updated motor_controller.h to replace the non-existent ce_m_driver.h include with the correct cem_driver.h include.
detailSummary: The motor_controller.h file contained an include directive for 'drivers/ce_m_driver.h' which does not exist in the codebase. The file was edited to change this include to 'drivers/cem_driver.h', which is the correct driver header. This change was made to fix a broken include that would cause compilation failures. The MOTOR_CEM preprocessor define is used as a guard for this include. The ce_m_driver.h file was never created in the repository, suggesting it was a typo or naming error. The cem_driver.h file exists and is the intended driver for motor control functionality. This fix ensures the build system can locate the correct driver header file when MOTOR_CEM is defined.
keyPatterns: Driver headers located in src/drivers/ directory
Use correct driver naming convention (cem_driver.h not ce_m_driver.h)
verification: Shell command 'ls src/drivers/ce_m_driver.*' returns exit code 2 (file does not exist), confirming ce_m_driver.h was never present
